# Trim

Removes white space from both ends of text.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Trim(text)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to trim. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. |

## Returns

String. The text without the white space at its start and its end; white space inside it is kept. White space is every character that Unicode version 15 gives the White_Space property. Never null.

## Example

`Trim("  a b  ")` returns `"a b"`.
